note: Village of Clear Lake's 260-acre park with three small campgrounds: Main (sites 1-11 on a lane above Ice House Lake; site 3 looks through the pines to the water; site 7 is tight for slide-outs), Pine Point (sites 18-24 on Clear Lake's north shore, behind its loop road and a campers' shelter; pit toilet only, showers and dump at Main) and primitive Maple Knoll (tents and pop-ups). Beach, boat landing; showers are coin-operated. Untagged sites are first-come self-register Fri noon-Sun. --Claude
